comparison.objective: Calibrate a colorimeter with a blank, measure a sample at a requested wavelength, and return both cuvettes.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and insert individual cuvettes, operate buttons and a sliding hood, and perform reference-dependent instrument sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: A valid calibrated measurement record plus both cuvettes released in separate rack pockets; loss forces zero.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests bimanual many-body size separation through apertures, not instrument calibration or precision cuvette handling. No material rubric details are missing.
